top_signals.title: Hong Kong to Launch Dim Sum Bond Index in Offshore Yuan Hub Push
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong will launch an index for offshore yuan bonds, according to Chief Executive John Lee, betting that a market benchmark can boost trading activity and reinforce the city’s role as China’s premier offshore renminbi hub.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Inside South Korea’s university programs offering a direct route to Samsung and SK Hynix
top_signals.summary: Companies are helping universities develop courses, provide financial support and create pathways through which qualifying students can join them.
